Job Description:
Job Description
We are looking for a motivated Working Student to support our Sales Team in Austria. This role is a great opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced commercial environment and work closely with the team on day-to-day customer and sales activities.
Key Responsibilities
Support the Sales Team with customer and business analysis
Prepare sales reports, presentations and customer meeting materials
Track key sales KPIs and commercial performance
Support customer planning, promotions and follow-up activities
Coordinate information across Sales and other functions
Support ad-hoc projects and administrative activities
Profile
Currently enrolled at university, ideally in Business, Economics, Marketing or a related field
Strong analytical and organizational skills
Confident with Excel and PowerPoint
Proactive, curious and willing to learn
Strong communication skills and team mindset
Fluent German and good English
What can you expect from Mars?
Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles.
Join a purpose driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.
A strong focus on learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.
An industry competitive salary and benefits package, including company bonus.
